meta.pos: noun; noun; noun; noun; verb; verb; verb; verb; interj; interj; interj; interj; interj; interj; interj

defs.def: a reason, either true or invented, that you give to explain or defend your behaviour 借口；理由；辩解

ex.s: Ever watched your child try to get out of doing housework by making excuses?
ex.t: 有没有见过你的孩子找借口逃避做家务？

ex.s: One way to begin is to answer your own excuses.
ex.t: 开始的方法之一是回应你自己的借口。

ex.s: One thing I think we all agree on, though, is that saying “My AI did it” won’t be any excuse for illegal or immoral behaviour!
ex.t: 不过我想我们都同意一点：说“是我的人工智能干的”绝不能成为非法或不道德行为的借口！

defs.def: a good reason that you give for doing sth that you want to do for other reasons （正当的）理由，借口
a very bad example of sth 拙劣样品；蹩脚货
a note written by a parent or doctor to explain why a student cannot go to school or sb cannot go to work 假条（家长或医生写明请假或给假理由）
to forgive sb for sth that they have done, for example not being polite or making a small mistake 原谅；宽恕
to make your or sb else's behaviour seem less offensive by finding reasons for it 为 … 辩解（或找理由）
to allow sb to leave; to say in a polite way that you are leaving 准许 … 离开；请求准予离开；（离开前）请求原谅

ex.s: Short writings missed as a result of an excused absence will be accepted.
ex.t: 因准予缺勤而错过的短写作业将被接受。

ex.s: it’s much easier to excuse yourself to get back to your work than if you try to get someone out of your space even after explaining how busy you are
ex.t: 39 . 为自己找借口回到工作中，要比在解释了自己有多忙之后还试图把某人从你的空间里请走容易得多。

ex.s: 39  , it’s much easeier to excuse yourself to get back to your work than if you try to get someone out of your space even after explaining how busy you are
ex.t: 39  ，在这种情况下，找借口回去工作要比试图把某人请出你的空间容易得多——即使你已经解释了自己有多忙。

defs.def: to allow sb to not do sth that they should normally do 同意免除；同意免做
（引起尤其是陌生人的注意）劳驾，请原谅

ex.s: "Excuse me, sir, are you Bob?" Bob heard the voice of a young man.
ex.t: “不好意思，先生，您是鲍勃吗？”鲍勃听到了一个年轻人的声音。

ex.s: Now, if you’ll excuse me, I really must go home.
ex.t: 好，请原谅，我真的得回家了。

defs.def: （客气地请人让路）对不起，劳驾，借光
（因打扰别人或失礼表示歉意）对不起，请原谅

ex.s: Thirty years later， a woman approached me in a public place． "Excuse me， did you ever enter a residence， long ago， thinking it was the McNay Museum？"
ex.t: 三十年后，一位女士在公共场所走近我。“打扰一下，你很久以前是否曾进过一户住宅，以为那是麦克奈博物馆？”

ex.s: This may be preceded with an apology such as Sorry,… or Excuse me,… Usually we interrupt someone when they pause for breath, or during the slight pause between spoken clauses.
ex.t: 这前面可能先说一句道歉，比如“抱歉……”或“打扰一下……”。通常我们在别人换气停顿、或在话语小句之间的短暂停顿时插话。

defs.def: （婉转地表示不赞成）对不起，请原谅，很抱歉
（婉转地要求离开或要与另外的人讲话）对不起，请原谅，抱歉

ex.s: Sorry to interrupt, but… Excuse me, but can I just ask…?
ex.t: 抱歉打断一下，但…… 不好意思，我能问一下……？

defs.def: （因挤着别人或做错了事表示歉意）对不起，请原谅，很抱歉
（没听清楚，请对方再说一遍）对不起，请再说一遍
